# jdbscript

> Type-safe database fixtures for JVM tests: seed, reset and assert relational database state from typed Java interfaces, with no XML or SQL scripts. Also tests what a Liquibase or Flyway migration does to existing data. Maven: `org.jdbscript:jdbscript`.

Record method names are used verbatim as column names (`user_id`, not `userId`).

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberdruid-dev/jdbscript/main/README.md): installation, API, assertions, migration testing, supported databases, known limitations
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberdruid-dev/jdbscript/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberdruid-dev/jdbscript/main/skill/jdbscript/SKILL.md): how to model schemas and write fixtures correctly. Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add https://jdbscript.org/marketplace.json`, then `/plugin install jdbscript@jdbscript`. Other agents: copy `skill/jdbscript/` into the agent's skills directory
- [Example patterns](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberdruid-dev/jdbscript/main/skill/jdbscript/reference/examples.md): condensed snippets from the example projects
- [Migration testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberdruid-dev/jdbscript/main/skill/jdbscript/reference/migrations.md): testing Liquibase/Flyway migrations against existing data
